$comment: The discoverability fields of doc-html-translate, typed once (ticket 111, canon PROMOTION section 2): what GitHub, winget, the Store and the extension listings are told to be found by. Derived from docs/POSITIONING.md; tests/discoverability_test.go holds the build-owned lists (winget Tags, Store search terms) against this file. A term enters a list only through allowedTags; a competitor's name never enters this file - the closed vocabulary is what keeps one out.

github.description: Ebook and document converter to local HTML: read EPUB, PDF, MOBI, FB2 and comic archives (CBZ/CBR) as a clean page with a table of contents, then translate it with your browser's own page translation - free, no key. OCR for scans. Windows app, Chrome and Edge extension.

droppedTerms.reason: names a translation service as a keyword: the free path is the browser's own page translation, and Google Cloud Translation is an optional engine on the user's own key
an optional local engine, not what the product is; it brought a community the product does not serve first
too generic to rank for and implied by windows-app

droppedPhrases.reason: the free path is the browser's online page translation, which sends the page text out; only conversion and reading are local
the user-initiated log report and the optional Google Cloud path leave the machine
